claims.statement: ./script/test-dsp.sh is the canonical DSP test loop: it configures the build directory if needed, builds --target DspTests, and execs the DspTests binary with any optional gtest filter. The binary can also be run directly by hand: cmake --build build --target DspTests, then the binary in build/test/DspTests_artefacts (also registered with ctest).

DspTests is a JUCE console app (juce_add_console_app) whose target_sources list compiles the real plugin sources (../plugin/src/AutoOffset.cpp, BlockEq.cpp, ConvolutionReverb.cpp, BudgetConvolver.cpp, Chorus.cpp, Delay.cpp, MidiMapper.cpp, NamEngine.cpp, PresetFile.cpp, PresetManager.cpp, Processor.cpp, ProcessorChain.cpp, ProcessorModelLoader.cpp, StandaloneStateAutosave.cpp, etc.) — compiled straight from the plugin tree so the tests exercise the real processor, not a copy.

GUI sources are excluded from DspTests: the only UI file pulled in is plugin/ui/core/Labels.cpp (the KnobScale readout formatter the scale-contract tests link), with plugin/ui/core on the include path — so a green DspTests run does not prove the UI links.

The fixture set in test/files/ ships the ground truth: NAM A2 captures (a2-am-test-2.nam, a2-amp-test.nam, a2-amp-cab-test.nam), cabinet IRs (cab-ir-test.wav, cab-ir-test-2.wav), reverb IRs (reverb-ir-mono-test.wav, reverb-ir-stereo-test.wav), and em240-gold-plate-5s.wav, the EMT 240 plate reference used by the plate-mode law tests.

DspTests compiles the real StandaloneStateAutosave portable no-op stub (not the iOS-only .mm observer) because Processor.cpp's constructor calls StandaloneStateAutosave::install(); this suite never runs where the real observer would be compiled.

The plate guard suite lives in three registered test files in test/CMakeLists.txt: src/plate_comb_tests.cpp, src/plate_family_tests.cpp (added 2026-10-13 final pass: P1 EMT140 family table, P2 cross-model, P4 knob laws incl. SizeLaw, P5 stereo image, P6 cap/CPU, with guards re-pinned to the final Plate/'140' state), and src/plate_texture_tests.cpp (baselines re-pinned that pass: level 78.23, comb 19.39).

The R1 reverb Dry anchor test TEST(ProcessorTest, ReverbDryScalesOnlyTheDryPathAllModes) (test/src/processor_tests.cpp, ~822, added alongside the convolver analogue) loops all 6 reverb modes; at mix=0 it asserts a -6 dB Dry setting scales the dry term by exactly gain(-6 dB); at mix=1 it asserts the wet (reverb tail) output is invariant under the Dry knob. It runs in ~460 ms and passes.

The DspTests suite grows with features (a count here is a lower-bound snapshot, never assert a stale total on a red run): 470 after R1 (reverbDry), 476 after R2 (reverb shared Mod + Digital 5-detent Shape), 477 after the first R2 follow-up, and 487 after the thirteenth/final R2 cut (2026-10-15, commit 1aa620e). The R2 measurement infrastructure is standing: 15 tests in test/src/effect_tests.cpp — R2_SharedModZeroIsBitExactAllSixModes, R2_SharedModOnStaysSineInEveryMode, R2_SharedModOnChangesOutputEveryMode, R2_ModClickSharpnessSweep, R2_ModTransientHunt, R2_ModWriteTauSonicSweep (body/tilt/sharpness vs write-tau 12/20/40/80 ms), R2_ModChordClickHunt (click-index guard; 0.048 @12ms → 0.0073 @80ms vs 0.351 unsmoothed), R2_ModVoicesSpikeSweep, R2_ModClickSpikeSweep, R2_ModTailClickSweep, R2_ModSonicSweep, R2_ModSonicProbe, R2_SharedModChorusesTheTailNotTheAttack, R2_WaveValue0IsExactSine, R2_DigitalWaveShapesTheWaverNotTheSharedMod — plus TEST(PlateTexture, R2_CpuWithSharedModOn) in plate_texture_tests.cpp. These tests are deliberate measurement infrastructure (sweeps + guarded pins), per docs/agents/dsp-invariants.md, because the R2 Mod mechanism was chosen by user A/B on shipped Windows exes, not by metric alone.
